title.en: Xenophon completes the Anabasis

summary.en: The Greek historian Xenophon, while in exile in Sparta, wrote the Anabasis (The Persian Expedition), recounting the harrowing journey of ten thousand Greek mercenaries from Babylon deep in Persia northwards across the Armenian mountains to Trapezus on the Black Sea in 401-399 BC. The book details the mercenaries' organization, tactics, negotiations, and the customs of Persians

statement.zh: 希腊历史学家色诺芬在斯巴达流亡期间撰写了《长征记》（又译《万人远征记》），记录公元前401年至前399年，一万名希腊雇佣军从波斯腹地巴比伦北上，穿越亚美尼亚雪山。最终抵达黑海特拉佩祖斯的艰险历程。书中详细描述了雇佣军的组织、战术、谈判以及沿途的波斯、亚美尼亚部落的风土人情，成为后世研究波斯帝国行省制度和希腊军事史的第一手文献。
statement.en: The Greek historian Xenophon wrote "The Long March" (also translated as "The Long March") while in exile in Sparta, recording that from 401 BCE to 399 BCE, 10,000 Greek mercenaries went north from Babylon, the heart of Persia, and crossed the snowy mountains of Armenia.

title.en: Pharaoh Amyrtaeus of Egypt's 28th Dynasty defeated and killed

summary.en: After Egypt threw off Persian rule, Pharaoh Amyrtaeus of the 28th Dynasty tried to consolidate power in Lower Egypt but was defeated and killed by the general Nepherites I of Mendes. Nepherites established the 29th Dynasty, moving the capital to Mendes. Egypt again fell into civil war, weakening its ability to resist a Persian reconquest.

statement.zh: 埃及摆脱波斯统治后，第二十八王朝法老阿米尔塔伊俄斯试图巩固下埃及权力，但被来自门德斯的将军涅菲里特斯一世击败并杀死。

title.en: Death of Socrates

summary.en: In 399 BCE the Athenian court condemns the about-seventy-year-old Socrates to death for “corrupting the youth” and “impiety”. He drinks hemlock; his life and words survive through the writings of his disciples Plato and Xenophon, his death a testament to the philosophic life.

statement.zh: 前399年，苏格拉底被雅典法庭以“败坏青年”“不敬城邦之神”判处死刑，年约七十，饮毒堇汁而亡。其言行由弟子柏拉图、色诺芬记述传世，以死印证哲学生活。审判在城邦危机之后进行，被告的诘问触怒公众；狱中的对话与临刑的从容，成为后世讨论哲人与城邦关系的起点。
statement.en: In 399 BCE, Socrates was sentenced to death by the Athenian court for "corrupting youth" and "disrespecting the gods of the city".

statement.zh: 埃及将军涅菲里特斯一世在孟菲斯称法老，建立第二十九王朝。他立即着手修筑防御工事，以防波斯帝国再次入侵。同时与斯巴达结盟，提供粮食和战船换取斯巴达牵制波斯。埃及短暂恢复了独立，但内部王位争夺激烈，为第三十王朝的动荡埋下伏笔。
statement.en:
The Egyptian general Nepherites I proclaimed himself pharaoh at Memphis, founding the 29th Dynasty. He immediately began fortifying defenses against a potential Persian invasion, while also allying with Sparta, providing grain and warships in exchange for Spartan pressure on Persia. Egypt briefly enjoyed independence, but internal struggles for the throne intensified, setting the stage for the turmoil of the 30th Dynasty.

statement.zh: 科林斯战争进入胶着状态，双方在斯巴达举行和平谈判。雅典提出保留新修建的雅典-比雷埃夫斯长城以及三十艘战船的海军，斯巴达则坚持要求雅典彻底拆除城墙并解散海军，恢复公元前404年投降时的状态。由于斯巴达驻军底比斯的问题无法调和，谈判破裂，但双方达成口头休战协议，暂停大规模军事行动一年。这是科林斯战争期间首次重大外交尝试。
statement.en:
With the Corinthian War at a stalemate, peace talks were held at Sparta. Athens proposed keeping its newly rebuilt Long Walls and a navy of 30 ships, while Sparta insisted on complete demolition of the walls and dissolution of the navy, returning to the state of surrender in 404 BC. The negotiations broke down over the issue of Sparta's garrison in Thebes, but the two sides reached an informal truce suspending major operations for a year. This was the first major diplomatic attempt during the Corinthian War.

title.en: Plato sails to Syracuse for the first time

summary.en: Plato accepted an invitation from the Syracusan tyrant Dionysius I and sailed to Sicily, hoping to put his ideal of the philosopher-king into practice. But Dionysius was ill-tempered and valued force over philosophy, leading to a violent quarrel. In anger, Dionysius handed Plato over to a Spartan envoy, who sold him into slavery on the island of Aegina. He was ransomed by his f

statement.zh: 柏拉图应叙拉古僭主狄奥尼修斯一世之邀，渡海前往西西里岛，试图实践“哲学王”的理想。然而狄奥尼修斯性情暴躁，崇尚武力而非哲学，两人因政见不合激烈争吵。狄奥尼修斯一怒之下将柏拉图交给斯巴达使者，后者在伊齐那岛将柏拉图当做奴隶出售，幸得友人安尼塞里斯赎回。这次失败经历让柏拉图意识到理想政治在现实中难以实现。
statement.en:
Plato accepted an invitation from the Syracusan tyrant Dionysius I and sailed to Sicily, hoping to put his ideal of the philosopher-king into practice. But Dionysius was ill-tempered and valued force over philosophy, leading to a violent quarrel. In anger, Dionysius handed Plato over to a Spartan envoy, who sold him into slavery on the island of Aegina. He was ransomed by his friend Anniceris. This failure convinced Plato that ideal politics could hardly be realized in reality.

For Europe in 391 BCE, “Plato sails to Syracuse for the first time” is a traceable node of Figure change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Gauls sack Rome

summary.en: Brennus, chieftain of the Gallic Senones, led about 40,000 tribesmen across the Apennines, defeated the Roman army thoroughly at the Allia, then marched into Rome unopposed. Except for the temple on the Capitoline Hill, the city was burned to the ground and the senators were massacred. The Gauls besieged the Capitoline for seven months. The defenders starved and finally agreed

statement.zh: 高卢塞农人首领布伦努斯率领约四万部落战士越过亚平宁山脉，在阿利亚河彻底击溃罗马军队，随后长驱直入攻入罗马城。除了卡皮托利山岗上的神庙外，全城被焚烧殆尽，元老院贵族被屠杀。高卢人围困卡皮托利山七个月，罗马守军粮尽援绝，最终同意以一千磅黄金赎城。在称量黄金时，布伦努斯故意使用加重的假砝码，罗马指挥官卡米卢斯恰在此时率援军赶到，击败高卢人。罗马此后重建了赛维安城墙并推行军事改革。
statement.en:
Brennus, chieftain of the Gallic Senones, led about 40,000 tribesmen across the Apennines, defeated the Roman army thoroughly at the Allia, then marched into Rome unopposed. Except for the temple on the Capitoline Hill, the city was burned to the ground and the senators were massacred. The Gauls besieged the Capitoline for seven months. The defenders starved and finally agreed to pay 1,000 pounds of gold as ransom. While weighing the gold, Brennus used heavier false weights, but the Roman commander Camillus arrived with reinforcements and drove off the Gauls. Rome rebuilt the Servian Wall and undertook military reforms.

For Europe in 390 BCE, “Gauls sack Rome” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.en: To escape the threat of the Three Jins from the north, King Dao of Chu moved the capital from Ying (Yong) to Jinan (modern Jingzhou, Hubei) on the Yangtze. statement.zh: 楚悼王为躲避北方三晋的威胁，将都城从鄢郢迁至长江之滨的纪南城（今湖北荆州）。新都城建有宫殿台榭、手工作坊和烽火台，城墙周长15公里，成为战国时期南方最大的都会。楚国由此加强对长江中游的控制，并开始与巴、蜀争夺西南地区。
statement.en:
To escape the threat of the Three Jins from the north, King Dao of Chu moved the capital from Ying (Yong) to Jinan (modern Jingzhou, Hubei) on the Yangtze. The new capital had palaces, terraces, workshops and beacon towers, with walls 15 km in circumference, becoming the largest southern metropolis of the Warring States period. Chu thus strengthened its control over the middle Yangtze and began contending with Ba and Shu for the southwest.

For Asia in 390 BCE, “Chu moves its capital to Ying (Jinan)” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 法家代表人物商鞅（公孙鞅）出生于卫国贵族家庭，早年学习李悝、吴起的变法思想。他后来在魏国相公叔痤门下任中庶子，公叔痤临终前向魏惠王推荐鞅，惠王不用。商鞅听说秦孝公求贤令，携带《法经》西入秦国，开启了著名的变法。
statement.en:
The Legalist reformer Shang Yang (Gongsun Yang) was born into an aristocratic family in the state of Wei. In his youth he studied the reform ideas of Li Kui and Wu Qi. Later he served as a minor official under the Wei prime minister Gongshu Cuo, who on his deathbed recommended him to King Hui of Wei, but the king did not use him. Hearing that Duke Xiao of Qin had issued a call for talent, Shang Yang took the Canon of Laws and went west to Qin, launching the famous reforms.

summary.en: Marquis Wen of Wei appointed Wu Qi as general. In the Hexi region, Wu Qi selected 50,000 tall, strong soldiers, outfitting them with three layers of armor, carrying crossbows and halberds, and making them march 50 li carrying heavy loads. title.en: Democritus completes his atomic theory

summary.en: The ancient Greek philosopher Democritus completed works such as the Great World System in Abdera, systematically expounding atomism: the universe consists of indivisible atoms and void; differences in atomic shape, size and arrangement account for all differences among things. He also proposed that 'soul atoms' are spherical and most active, explaining perception and thought.

statement.zh: 古希腊哲学家德谟克利特在阿布德拉完成《大宇宙》等著作，系统阐述了原子论：宇宙由不可分割的原子和虚空组成，原子形状、大小和排列方式的不同造就了万物的差异。
statement.en: The ancient Greek philosopher Democritus completed works such as the Great World System in Abdera, systematically expounding atomism: the universe consists of indivisible atoms and void; differences in atomic shape, size and arrangement account for all differences among things.

en: The ancient Greek philosopher Democritus completed works such as the Great World System in Abdera, systematically expounding atomism: the universe consists of indivisible atoms and void; differences in atomic shape, size and arrangement account for all differences among things.

title.en: Athens introduces pay for public office

summary.en: The Athenian Assembly passed a law granting daily pay of two obols (about half a day's labor wage) to jurors and members of the Council. The measure, proposed by the democratic leader Argyrios, aimed to enable poor citizens to participate in politics. However, it also increased the fiscal burden, forcing Athens to tighten tribute collection from its allies.

title.en: Reconstitution of the Boeotian League

summary.en: Thebes formally organized a new Boeotian League comprising eleven cities including Thebes, Coronea, Orchomenus and Thespiae. Sparta declared this a violation of the King's Peace and began preparing to march against Thebes.

title.en: Euclid born in Athens

summary.en: The ancient Greek mathematician Euclid was born in Athens. Later, under the patronage of Ptolemy I, he went to teach at the Musaeum of Alexandria, where he wrote the Elements, systematically organizing the geometry of his time into thirteen books, deducing 467 propositions from five postulates. The Elements became the most widely circulated textbook in the history of science.

title.en: Construction of the Mausoleum at Halicarnassus begins

summary.en: Mausolus, satrap of Caria in the Persian Empire, began building a tomb for himself at his capital Halicarnassus (modern Bodrum, Turkey). The project brought together Greek, Egyptian and Persian architects. The base was a square podium, surrounded by thirty-six Ionic columns, topped with a pyramidal roof, and crowned by a statue of a four-horse chariot. This tomb would later be

statement.zh: 波斯帝国卡里亚总督摩索拉斯开始为自己修建陵墓，选址都城哈利卡纳索斯（今土耳其博德鲁姆）。工程汇聚希腊、埃及和波斯的建筑师，底部为方形墓基，中间环绕36根爱奥尼柱，顶部为金字塔形屋顶，最上方是四马战车雕像。这座陵墓后来被称为“摩索拉斯陵墓”，列入古代世界七大奇迹。
statement.en:
Mausolus, satrap of Caria in the Persian Empire, began building a tomb for himself at his capital Halicarnassus (modern Bodrum, Turkey). The project brought together Greek, Egyptian and Persian architects. The base was a square podium, surrounded by 36 Ionic columns, topped with a pyramidal roof, and crowned by a statue of a four-horse chariot. title.en: Wu Qi's reforms in Chu fail, and he is killed

summary.en: King Dao of Chu appointed Wu Qi to carry out reforms: abolishing aristocratic privileges, reducing stipends, and moving nobles with no office for three generations to frontier regions to open wasteland. statement.zh: 楚悼王任用吴起进行变法，废除贵族特权，削减俸禄，将三代无官贵族迁往边远地区开垦。楚悼王死后，旧贵族发动叛乱，射杀吴起，吴起趴在楚悼王尸体上，箭射中王尸。新王楚肃王借机杀七十多家贵族，但废除了大部分变法措施，只有户籍制度和军功爵位保留。
statement.en:
King Dao of Chu appointed Wu Qi to carry out reforms: abolishing aristocratic privileges, reducing stipends, and moving nobles with no office for three generations to frontier regions to open wasteland. After King Dao's death, the old nobles rose in rebellion and shot Wu Qi. He threw himself onto the king's corpse, and the arrows hit the dead king's body as well. The new king, King Su of Chu, used this as a pretext to execute over seventy noble families, but most of the reform measures were abolished, leaving only the household registration system and military ranks.

statement.zh: 雅典劳里昂银矿在伯罗奔尼撒战争后重新投入大规模开采，矿工采用新式的巷道掘进和水力冲洗法，每年产出约二十吨白银。矿场采用奴隶劳动和契约分包制，收入一半归国库，一半归承包商人。比雷埃夫斯港的贸易量恢复到战前水平，陶器、葡萄酒和橄榄油出口持续增长。

The mines were operated with slave labor and contract farming, with half the proceeds going to the treasury and half to the contractors. Trade at Piraeus returned to pre-war levels, and exports of pottery, wine and olive oil continued to grow.

statement.zh: 儒家思想家孟子（名轲）出生于邹国（今山东邹城）。他受业于子思门人，发展了孔子学说，提出性善论，认为人生来就有恻隐、羞恶、辞让、是非四端。他游说齐宣王、梁惠王等君主，主张仁政和王道，反对霸道和兼并战争。虽未被重用，但后世被尊为‘亚圣’。
statement.en:
The Confucian thinker Mencius (Meng Ke) was born in Zou (modern Zoucheng, Shandong). He studied under a disciple of Zisi and developed Confucius' teachings. He proposed the theory of the innate goodness of human nature, arguing that humans are born with four 'sprouts': compassion, shame, deference, and right and wrong. He traveled to courts such as Qi and Liang, advocating benevolent government and the way of the king, opposing hegemonism and annexation wars. Although not employed in his time, he was later honored as the 'Second Sage'.

For Asia in 372 BCE, “Mencius born in the state of Zou” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: King Wei of Qi improves administration, Qi becomes strong

summary.en: After ascending the throne, King Wei of Qi summoned the magistrates of Jimo and A to personally assess their performance. He lavishly rewarded the magistrate of Jimo and boiled alive the magistrate of A and his accomplices. The state of Qi was shaken. King Wei then appointed Zou Ji as chancellor, who revised the laws, supervised officials, and opened markets to attract merchant

statement.zh: 齐威王即位后，召见即墨大夫和阿大夫，当面考核政绩。他重赏即墨大夫而烹杀阿大夫及其帮凶，齐国震动。威王又任命邹忌为相，修订法律，监督官吏，并开放市场招揽商人。齐国逐渐成为东方强国。
statement.en:
After ascending the throne, King Wei of Qi summoned the magistrates of Jimo and A to personally assess their performance. He lavishly rewarded the magistrate of Jimo and boiled alive the magistrate of A and his accomplices. The state of Qi was shaken. King Wei then appointed Zou Ji as chancellor, who revised the laws, supervised officials, and opened markets to attract merchants. Qi gradually became a powerful state in the east.

For Asia in 368 BCE, “King Wei of Qi improves administration, Qi becomes strong” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Persian Empire suppresses the revolt of western satraps

summary.en: Ariobarzanes, satrap of western Asia Minor, rebelled and proclaimed himself king. Persian king Artaxerxes II sent forces to suppress him, and after two years of war, took Assos and executed Ariobarzanes. Persia regained control of Ionia and the Hellespont, but its power was greatly weakened.

title.en: Second Athenian League begins to collapse

summary.en: Athens imposed tribute and stationed garrisons on Delos, Euboea and other allies, violating the league's charter. Chios, Rhodes, Cos and Byzantium successively seceded and turned to Persia for protection. The Athenian admiral Chares led fifty ships to suppress them, starting the Social War.

For Europe in 365 BCE, “Second Athenian League begins to collapse” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Philip II reforms the Macedonian army

statement.zh: 被底比斯扣作人质的腓力二世在底比斯学习伊巴密浓达的战术和军事组织，归国后被兄长佩尔狄卡斯三世任命为摄政。他开始改革马其顿军队：将步兵组成十六排纵深的马其顿方阵，每名士兵配备6米长的萨里沙长矛；建立重装骑兵（伙友骑兵）作为突击力量；发明了可移动的攻城塔和扭力投石机。马其顿军力开始质变。
statement.en:
Philip II, who had been a hostage in Thebes, learned Epaminondas' tactics and military organization. After returning to Macedon, he was appointed regent by his brother King Perdiccas III. He began reforming the Macedonian army: infantry were formed into a phalanx sixteen ranks deep, each man armed with a 6-meter sarissa; heavy cavalry (the Companions) were established as a shock force; and he invented mobile siege towers and torsion catapults. The military power of Macedon began to transform.

title.en: Battle of Mantinea and death of Epaminondas

summary.en: Four armies – Thebes, Sparta, Athens and Mantinea – met on the plain of Mantinea. Epaminondas again used the Leuctra tactic, concentrating his elite on the left wing and breaking the Spartan right, but while pursuing, he was struck in the chest by a Spartan javelin and died three days later. Thebes won the battle but lost its greatest general, and its hegemony rapidly declined.

statement.zh: 21岁的秦孝公即位，痛感秦国被魏国夺取河西之地，向东出函谷关的道路被阻。他在国都栎阳颁布求贤令，承诺：‘宾客群臣有能出奇计强秦者，吾且尊官，与之分土。’卫国人商鞅（公孙鞅）携带《法经》西入秦国，通过景监三见秦孝公，最终以霸道之术打动孝公，开启了中国历史上最彻底的变法。
statement.en:
The 21-year-old Duke Xiao of Qin, distressed that Qin had lost the Hexi region to Wei and that its eastern exit through Hangu Pass was blocked, issued a call for talent at the capital Yueyang, promising: 'If any guest or minister can devise a brilliant plan to strengthen Qin, I will give him high office and share the land with him.' Shang Yang (Gongsun Yang) from Wei, carrying the Canon of Laws, went west to Qin. Through three audiences arranged by the eunuch Jing Jian, he finally persuaded Duke Xiao with his doctrine of state power, launching the most thorough reform in Chinese history.

For Asia in 361 BCE, “Duke Xiao of Qin issues an order seeking talent” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 马其顿国王佩尔狄卡斯三世在与伊利里亚人的作战中阵亡，腓力二世从底比斯回国，被军队拥立为王，年仅23岁。他立即进行军队改革，收服西部的林克斯提斯部落，并在潘盖翁山开采金矿，每年收入一千塔兰特，发行腓力金币成为国际结算货币，迅速增强了马其顿的国力。

He issued the gold Philippus coin, which became an international medium of exchange, swiftly strengthening Macedonia.

For Europe in 359 BCE, “Philip II formally ascends as king of Macedon” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.en: Philip II led 20,000 troops north against Paeonia. At the Battle of the Lychnius valley, he defeated King Agis of Paeonia using phalanx breakthrough tactics. title.en: Social War ends; Athens admits defeat

summary.en: The Athenian fleet was defeated by the Allies' fleet off Byzantium, losing thirty ships and exhausting the treasury. Athens was forced to sign a peace recognizing the independence of Chios, Rhodes, Cos and Byzantium, and abandoning its right to collect tolls in the Hellespont. The Second Athenian League effectively dissolved, and Athens retreated to Attica, becoming a second-ra

statement.zh: 雅典舰队在拜占庭附近海域被盟友同盟击败，三十艘战船被毁，国库枯竭。雅典被迫与各盟邦签订和约，承认开俄斯、罗得斯、科斯、拜占庭四邦独立，并放弃在赫勒斯滂海峡的征税权。第二次雅典同盟实际上解体，雅典退回阿提卡半岛，沦为二流城邦。
statement.en:
The Athenian fleet was defeated by the Allies' fleet off Byzantium, losing 30 ships and exhausting the treasury. Athens was forced to sign a peace recognizing the independence of Chios, Rhodes, Cos and Byzantium, and abandoning its right to collect tolls in the Hellespont. The Second Athenian League effectively dissolved, and Athens retreated to Attica, becoming a second-rate power.

For Europe in 355 BCE, “Social War ends; Athens admits defeat” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Philip II besieges Methone, loses an eye

summary.en: Philip II led his army to besiege the coastal Macedonian city of Methone. During an assault, a bolt from a ballista fired by a defender pierced Philip's right eye, damaging the eyeball. statement.zh: 腓力二世率军围攻马其顿沿海城市麦通。在一次攻城战中，守城士兵用弩炮发射的箭矢射穿腓力右眼，箭头伤及眼球。军医取出眼球并保留箭镞作为纪念，腓力忍着剧痛继续指挥，最终攻陷城池。他善待俘虏，仅流放反抗居民，但禁止任何人当面提‘独眼’二字。
statement.en:
Philip II led his army to besiege the coastal Macedonian city of Methone. During an assault, a bolt from a ballista fired by a defender pierced Philip's right eye, damaging the eyeball. The army surgeon removed the eye but kept the arrowhead as a souvenir. Philip continued to command in agony, eventually taking the city. He treated the prisoners leniently, only exiling the resistors, but forbade anyone to mention the word 'one-eyed' in his presence.

For Europe in 354 BCE, “Philip II besieges Methone, loses an eye” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.en:
The Phocians occupied the temple of Apollo at Delphi and looted the vast wealth accumulated there over nearly a century, including gold and silver vessels and votive offerings, totalling over 10,000 talents. They used this wealth to hire a 20,000-strong mercenary army. The Amphictyonic League, led by Thebes, declared war on Phocis. Sparta and Athens supported Phocis, while Thebes and Macedon supported the League. Philip II intervened in Greek affairs under the pretext of protecting the temple.

For Europe in 353 BCE, “Third Sacred War breaks out” is a traceable node of Religion change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 腓力二世率领两万马其顿方阵和两千骑兵，在色萨利的克罗库斯平原与福基斯统帅奥诺马尔库斯率领的三万雇佣军决战。马其顿方阵用六米长枪组成枪林，冲垮了福基斯军阵，奥诺马尔库斯战死。腓力将六千名俘虏投入大海以示惩罚，色萨利同盟推举他为最高统帅。这是马其顿第一次在希腊核心地区获得军事发言权。
statement.en:
Philip II led 20,000 Macedonian phalangites and 2,000 cavalry against the Phocian general Onomarchus with 30,000 mercenaries at the Crocus Field in Thessaly. The Macedonian phalanx, with its six-meter pikes forming a wall of iron, shattered the Phocian army, and Onomarchus fell. Philip had 6,000 captives drowned as punishment. The Thessalian League elected him its supreme commander. This was the first time Macedonia had gained a military voice in central Greece.

statement.zh: 湖北江陵望山楚墓出土这一时期的漆器，有虎座凤鸟悬鼓、彩绘木雕座屏、云纹耳杯等。漆器以黑漆为地，用红、黄、金色绘出云纹、凤鸟纹和狩猎纹，木胎雕刻极为繁复。楚国设立工室专门管理漆器生产，产品远销中原、巴蜀和西南夷地区。
statement.en:
Lacquerware from the Chu tombs at Wangshan, Jiangling, Hubei, dates to this period, including tiger-and-phoenix drums, painted wood screens and cloud-patterned ear cups. Black lacquer was used as the base, with red, yellow and gold designs of clouds, phoenixes and hunting scenes. Wood carving is extremely intricate. The state of Chu established workshops to manage lacquer production, and the products were exported to the Central Plain, Ba-Shu and the southwestern barbarian regions.

title.en: The Jixia Academy gathers scholars at Linzi

summary.en: The state of Qi establishes the Jixia Academy at its capital Linzi, attracting scholars of Confucian, Daoist, Legalist and other schools, making it the intellectual center of the Warring States era.

statement.zh:
齐国在都城临淄设稷下学宫，招揽儒、道、法、名各家学者讲学论辩，成为战国时期学术中心。把不同学派的学者集中到同一座学宫，意味着争论可以在共同的场所中持续进行，而不必各自依附于封闭的门派；讲学与论辩并行，也使学说在传播中被反复修正。

把「齐国稷下学宫汇聚百家学者」放回公元前350年的战国，可以看到教育变化的一个具体切面。

statement.zh: 马其顿军队用攻城塔和破城锤围攻奥林索斯城。雅典派出三十艘战船救援，但被风暴阻隔。经过三个月围攻，马其顿撞破城墙，奥林索斯陷落。腓力将城市夷为平地，三万名居民卖为奴隶。雅典失去了最后一位强有力盟友，马其顿通往希腊中部的大门完全打开。

Athens lost its last powerful ally, and the door to central Greece was now wide open for Macedon.

statement.zh: 古希腊哲学家伊壁鸠鲁出生于萨摩斯岛，父亲是雅典移民。他在十四岁时开始学习哲学，十八岁前往雅典服兵役，后来在小亚细亚建立学校。伊壁鸠鲁在雅典创立‘花园学派’，主张人生最高目标是快乐，即身体无痛苦和灵魂无纷扰，发展德谟克利特的原子论。其思想与斯多葛主义并称希腊化时代两大哲学流派。
statement.en:
The ancient Greek philosopher Epicurus was born on Samos, the son of an Athenian immigrant. He began studying philosophy at fourteen, went to Athens for military service at eighteen, and later established a school in Asia Minor. He founded the 'Garden' school in Athens, teaching that the goal of life is happiness, which is freedom from bodily pain and mental disturbance. He developed Democritus's atomism. His thought, together with Stoicism, was one of the two major philosophical schools of the Hellenistic age.

In 341 BCE, “Epicurus born on Samos” belongs to the field of Culture in Europe.

title.en: Battle of Maling: Qi crushes Wei

summary.en: Pang Juan of Wei led 100,000 troops against Han. Qi sent Tian Ji as general and Sun Bin as adviser to save Han. Sun Bin used the 'diminishing stoves' stratagem: on the first day of retreat, they made 100,000 cooking pits, on the second day 50,000, on the third day 30,000. statement.zh: 魏国庞涓率十万大军攻韩，齐国以田忌为将、孙膑为军师救韩。孙膑用‘减灶’诱敌，在撤退时第一天造十万灶，第二天五万灶，第三天三万灶。庞涓以为齐军逃亡过半，抛弃步兵率轻锐追击。孙膑在马陵道（今山东莘县）设伏，万弩齐发，庞涓自刎。魏太子申被俘，十万魏军几乎全军覆没。此战终结了魏国的霸权，齐国崛起为东方强国。
statement.en:
Pang Juan of Wei led 100,000 troops against Han. Qi sent Tian Ji as general and Sun Bin as adviser to save Han. Sun Bin used the 'diminishing stoves' stratagem: on the first day of retreat, they made 100,000 cooking pits, on the second day 50,000, on the third day 30,000. Pang Juan concluded that Qi had lost half its army, abandoned his heavy infantry and pressed ahead with light troops. Sun Bin ambushed him at Maling (modern Shenxian, Shandong). 10,000 crossbows fired at once, and Pang Juan committed suicide. The Wei crown prince was captured, and nearly all of Wei's 100,000 troops were lost. This battle ended Wei's hegemony, and Qi rose as a powerful eastern state.

statement.zh: 秦孝公去世，太子驷即位（秦惠文王）。公子虔等旧贵族诬告商鞅谋反，商鞅逃亡至魏国，魏国因怨恨他过去欺骗公子卬而拒绝入境。商鞅回到秦地起兵，战败死于彤地。尸体被运回咸阳车裂示众，全家被灭。但秦惠文王保留了商鞅的新法，秦国持续强盛。
statement.en:
Duke Xiao of Qin died, and the crown prince Si ascended the throne as King Huiwen of Qin. The old aristocrats, led by Prince Qian, accused Shang Yang of plotting rebellion. Shang Yang fled to Wei, but Wei refused him entry because of his earlier deception of Prince Ang. He returned to Qin and raised troops, but was defeated and killed at Tong. His corpse was carted to Xianyang and torn apart by chariots, and his family was exterminated. However, King Huiwen retained Shang Yang's new laws, and Qin continued to grow strong.

statement.zh: 腓力二世与十八岁的亚历山大率三万马其顿军队，在喀罗尼亚迎战三万五千雅典-底比斯联军。亚历山大指挥左翼骑兵率先击溃底比斯圣队，腓力正面击退雅典方阵。联军大败，一千雅典人战死，两千被俘；底比斯圣队三百人全部战死。雅典和底比斯被迫接受马其顿驻军和亲马其顿的寡头政府，希腊城邦的独立到此结束。

Athens and Thebes were forced to accept Macedonian garrisons and pro-Macedonian oligarchies. The independence of the Greek city-states ended.

summary.en: Philip II was stabbed to death by his bodyguard Pausanias at the wedding of his daughter Cleopatra to the king of Epirus in the old capital Aegae. title.en: Alexander destroys Thebes to terrify Greece

summary.en: Thebes, taking advantage of a rumor that Alexander had died, rose in revolt and besieged the Macedonian garrison. Alexander force-marched from Illyria to Thebes in fifteen days, stormed the city, and ordered it razed to the ground, sparing only the temples and the house of the poet Pindar. Thirty thousand Thebans were sold into slavery. The Greek states were shocked and none da

statement.zh: 底比斯借谣传亚历山大死亡之机发动起义，包围马其顿驻军。亚历山大率军急行军十五天从伊利里亚赶到底比斯，攻城后下令将城市夷为平地，仅保留神庙和诗人品达的住宅。三万名底比斯人被卖为奴隶，希腊各邦震惊，再无人敢反叛。
statement.en:
Thebes, taking advantage of a rumor that Alexander had died, rose in revolt and besieged the Macedonian garrison. Alexander force-marched from Illyria to Thebes in fifteen days, stormed the city, and ordered it razed to the ground, sparing only the temples and the house of the poet Pindar. 30,000 Thebans were sold into slavery. The Greek states were shocked and none dared rebel again.

For Europe in 335 BCE, “Alexander destroys Thebes to terrify Greece” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.en:
Alexander financed Aristotle with 8,000 gold talents (equivalent to hundreds of millions of dollars today). Aristotle established a school at the Lyceum gymnasium in eastern Athens. He taught while walking, hence the school became known as the Peripatetic school. The school included a museum, a library and a zoo, housing biological specimens from all over Greece, covering all fields of knowledge.

Alexander besieged the island city of Tyre for seven months. He founded Alexandria at the mouth of the Nile, which became the cultural center of the Hellenistic world.

title.en: Alexandria founded

summary.en: Alexander the Great founded Alexandria in Egypt in 331 BC at the Nile mouth on the Mediterranean; it became the Ptolemaic capital and the ancient world's great centre of learning and its famous library, and a home of Jewish philosophy.

title.en: Alexander kills his close friend Cleitus in a drunken rage

summary.en: At a banquet in Samarkand, the veteran Cleitus, drunk, criticized Alexander for adopting Eastern customs and belittling his Macedonian veterans. Alexander seized a guard's spear and killed Cleitus. After sobering up, he wept and beat his chest for three days. statement.zh: 在撒马尔罕的一次宴会上，老将克利图斯酒后批评亚历山大崇拜东方习俗、轻视马其顿老战士。亚历山大夺过卫兵的标枪刺死了克利图斯，酒醒后捶胸痛哭三日。军队原谅了他，但他因此加速了东方化政策，要求波斯和希腊臣民对他行跪拜礼。
statement.en:
At a banquet in Samarkand, the veteran Cleitus, drunk, criticized Alexander for adopting Eastern customs and belittling his Macedonian veterans. Alexander seized a guard's spear and killed Cleitus. After sobering up, he wept and beat his chest for three days. The army forgave him, but the incident accelerated his orientalizing policies, including the demand that Persians and Greeks prostrate themselves before him.

For Asia in 328 BCE, “Alexander kills his close friend Cleitus in a drunken rage” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Battle of the Hydaspes and the army mutiny

summary.en: Alexander defeated the Indian king Porus at the Hydaspes River. Porus, though defeated, was so impressive that Alexander allowed him to continue ruling. When the soldiers learned that ahead lay the Ganges valley and the Nanda kingdom with 6,000 war elephants, they refused to go further. Alexander reluctantly agreed to turn back, marching south along the Indus.

title.en: Macedonian army crosses the Gedrosian Desert

summary.en: Alexander led his main army from the mouth of the Indus westward across the Gedrosian Desert (today's Pakistan-Iran border). The region was scorching hot and waterless; the army suffered huge losses from thirst and hunger, with nearly three-quarters of the soldiers and almost all the women and children dying. The admiral Nearchus led the fleet along the coast of the Indian Ocea

statement.zh: 亚历山大率主力从印度河口向西横穿格德罗西亚沙漠（今巴基斯坦-伊朗边境），该地区夏季酷热无雨，军队因缺水缺粮损失惨重，近四分之三的士兵和几乎所有的随行妇孺死亡。海军将领尼阿卡斯率舰队沿印度洋海岸航行，绘制了最早的阿拉伯海地图。
statement.en:
Alexander led his main army from the mouth of the Indus westward across the Gedrosian Desert (today's Pakistan-Iran border). The region was scorching hot and waterless; the army suffered huge losses from thirst and hunger, with nearly three-quarters of the soldiers and almost all the women and children dying. The admiral Nearchus led the fleet along the coast of the Indian Ocean, drawing the first map of the Arabian Sea.

For Asia in 325 BCE, “Macedonian army crosses the Gedrosian Desert” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Alexander the Great dies in Babylon

summary.en: Alexander, after a bout of heavy drinking in the palace of Nebuchadnezzar in Babylon, developed a high fever and died ten days later at the age of thirty-three. He left no designated heir, saying only that the empire should go 'to the strongest'. The empire immediately fell into the Wars of the Diadochi, splitting into the Hellenistic kingdoms of Seleucid, Ptolemaic, Antigonid,

statement.zh: 亚历山大在巴比伦尼布甲尼撒王宫连续饮酒后突发高烧，十天后病逝，终年33岁。他去世时未指定继承人，只说将帝国‘交给最强者’。帝国随即陷入继业者战争，分裂为塞琉古、托勒密、安提柯、吕辛马库斯等希腊化王国。
statement.en:
Alexander, after a bout of heavy drinking in the palace of Nebuchadnezzar in Babylon, developed a high fever and died ten days later at the age of 33. He left no designated heir, saying only that the empire should go 'to the strongest'. The empire immediately fell into the Wars of the Diadochi, splitting into the Hellenistic kingdoms of Seleucid, Ptolemaic, Antigonid, and Lysimachan.

For Asia in 323 BCE, “Alexander the Great dies in Babylon” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Rome suffers the disastrous Battle of the Caudine Forks

summary.en: During the Second Samnite War, the Roman army was trapped in a narrow defile at the Caudine Forks and surrounded by Samnites. summary.en: The victorious Diadochi met at Triparadisus in Syria to redistribute the satrapies: Antipater became European commander, Antigonus became Asian commander and was charged with pursuing Eumenes, Seleucus received Babylonia, Ptolemy retained Egypt. statement.zh: 秦惠文王派司马错、张仪率军从石牛道伐蜀，在葭萌击败蜀军，灭蜀国，贬蜀王为侯。随后顺江而下灭巴国，设巴郡。秦国获得成都平原粮仓，人口和财富倍增，为东出函谷关提供了战略后方。
statement.en:
King Huiwen of Qin sent Sima Cuo and Zhang Yi to invade Shu via the Stone Ox Road. They defeated the Shu army at Jiameng, annexed Shu and reduced its king to a marquis. Then they proceeded down the Yangtze, extinguished Ba, and established Ba Commandery. Qin gained the grain basket of the Chengdu Plain, doubling its population and wealth, and acquired a strategic rear base for eastward expansion through Hangu Pass.

For Asia in 316 BCE, “Qin conquers Ba and Shu” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Battle of Ipsus: Antigonus dies; Hellenistic pattern set

summary.en: Antigonus and his son Demetrius, with 80,000 infantry, 10,000 cavalry and 75 war elephants, met the allied forces of Seleucus, Lysimachus and Cassander (90,000 men) at Ipsus in Phrygia. Seleucus used his 500 Indian elephants to break Antigonus's cavalry charge. The eighty-year-old Antigonus was hit by a javelin and fell. His empire was partitioned: Seleucus received Syria and e

statement.zh: 安提柯父子率八万步兵、一万骑兵及75头战象，在弗里吉亚伊普苏斯与联军（塞琉古、吕辛马库斯、卡山德）九万军队决战。塞琉古使用五百头印度战象突破安提柯骑兵，八十岁的安提柯被标枪刺中阵亡。帝国被瓜分：塞琉古获叙利亚和小亚细亚东部，吕辛马库斯获小亚细亚西部，卡山德获马其顿，托勒密获埃及、巴勒斯坦和塞浦路斯。希腊化世界三足鼎立格局形成。
statement.en:
Antigonus and his son Demetrius, with 80,000 infantry, 10,000 cavalry and 75 war elephants, met the allied forces of Seleucus, Lysimachus and Cassander (90,000 men) at Ipsus in Phrygia. Seleucus used his 500 Indian elephants to break Antigonus's cavalry charge. The eighty-year-old Antigonus was hit by a javelin and fell. His empire was partitioned: Seleucus received Syria and eastern Asia Minor; Lysimachus received western Asia Minor; Cassander received Macedon; Ptolemy received Egypt, Palestine and Cyprus. The three-way structure of the Hellenistic world was established.

For Asia in 301 BCE, “Battle of Ipsus: Antigonus dies; Hellenistic pattern set” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Epictetus teaches Stoicism

statement.en:
In 300 BCE, Invited by Ptolemy I to teach at the Musaeum of Alexandria, Euclid completed the 13 books of 'The Elements'. Starting from five postulates and five common notions, he used strict logical deduction to derive 467 propositions, constructing the first axiomatic mathematical system. This work became a model for later mathematical and scientific theories, used as a textbook in the West for two thousand years.

title.en: Zeno founds Stoicism

summary.en: Zeno of Citium taught at the Stoa in Athens and founded Stoicism, an ethics of living by natural reason with self-mastery and indifference to fortune.

statement.zh: 塞浦路斯的芝诺在雅典画廊讲学，创立斯多葛学派，主张顺应自然理性、克己自足的伦理。“斯多葛”之名来自讲学的柱廊，学派把宇宙视为受理性支配的整体，人应以德性为唯一的善，对外物保持不动心。这一伦理后来经罗马的传播者扩展为涵盖逻辑、物理与伦理的完整体系，影响了法律与政治思想。

title.en: Petra carved in rock

summary.en: The Nabataeans carved Petra in Jordanian desert (c. 4th c BC-1st c AD) from rose-red sandstone: the Khazneh treasury, tombs and temples. Controlling the Arabia-Mediterranean spice trade and channelling water, they made a rich city of the wadi.

statement.zh: 纳巴泰人在约旦荒漠的佩特拉（约前4世纪—公元1世纪）沿玫瑰色砂岩崖壁凿出宝库、陵墓与神庙，控扼阿拉伯—地中海香料商路，并筑引水渠与蓄水池，荒谷中崛起为富强之城。岩壁的立面以柱式与浮雕仿照希腊化建筑，水利系统收集山洪；商队的税与过境贸易支撑城邦的繁荣。
statement.en: The Nabataeans carved out treasure houses, mausoleums and temples along the rose sandstone cliffs in Petra in the Jordanian desert (approximately 4th century BC - 1st century AD), controlled the Arab-Mediterranean spice trade route, and built aqueducts and cisterns.

title.en: Bo people's cliff-hanging coffins

summary.en: Ancient Bo and neighboring groups place coffins on beams in cliffs above the Yangtze gorges; many cliff tombs survive in southern Sichuan.

statement.zh: 古代僰人等族群在长江上游峡谷的临江悬崖上凿孔置棺悬葬，今川南宜宾一带留存大量悬棺遗迹。葬法在崖壁凿孔插木，把棺木置于横木之上，或利用天然岩腔安放，位置多高出江面，需借助绳索与栈道施工。这种葬俗与当地族的祖先观念和峡谷环境相关，遗存为研究古代族群提供了实物。
statement.en: In ancient times, the Bo people and other ethnic groups drilled holes in the riverside cliffs of the upper reaches of the Yangtze River and placed hanging coffins for burials.

statement.zh: 秦昭襄王七年（公元前300年），秦军再度大举攻楚，夺取新城（今河南伊川西南）等战略要地。楚军大败，主将景缺战死，损兵约两万，楚怀王被迫遣太子横入质于齐以求外援。此役进一步压缩了楚国的西北防线，为22年后白起攻破郢都埋下伏笔。
statement.en:
In 300 BCE, the seventh year of King Zhaoxiang of Qin, Qin again attacked Chu in force and seized Xincheng (southwest of modern Yichuan, Henan) and other strategic points. The Chu army was routed, its general Jing Que was killed and some 20,000 men were lost; King Huai of Chu had to send his heir as a hostage to Qi in search of allies. The campaign compressed Chu's north-western defences still further and prepared the ground for Bai Qi's capture of the Chu capital Ying 22 years later.

For Asia in 300 BCE, “Qin captured the Xincheng region of Chu” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.
